summary: Full validation of Sheet #18 (Marketplace & Pro Service Integration). Backend: 14/14 pytest pass in 2.45s (test_marketplace_pros.py). Covered: GET /api/pros returns 6 seeded verified+active partners with public shape only (id/name/trades/specialties/location/rating/reviews_count/verified/bio) and trades[] for filter chips (no _id leakage), filter by trade=Electrical narrows to BrightSpark, q=EV chargers matches by specialty, auth required (401 unauth). GET /api/pros/{id} returns matching pro, 404 unknown. POST /api/pros/apply creates a partner with verified=false/active=false — NOT visible in public /pros but visible in GET /api/admin/pros. GET /api/projects/{id}/pro-suggestion returns suggest=true + suggested_trade='Electrical' for 'Upgrade electrical panel', suggest=false for 'Paint a room'. GET /api/projects/{id}/handoff returns structured summary including project_title, materials[] and title text. POST /api/pro-referrals with pro_id + project_summary persists both fields, joins pro_name from db.pro_partners, and admin sees it in /api/admin/pro-leads. Admin gated (403 for standard user on /admin/pros and /admin/pro-leads). Admin CRUD: POST → PATCH (verify=true+active=true reveals partner publicly; active=false hides it) → DELETE. Frontend (Expo web): (1) User /pros (mobile 390x844) — logged in as demo_home@diyhomie.com → /pros lists 6 pro cards (pro-card-{id}) with logo initial, name, verified check-decagram, rating/reviews/location, bio, 3 specialty chips, and pro-quote-{id} 'REQUEST A QUOTE' CTA. pros-search filters ('Lone Star' → 1 card). pros-trade-Electrical chip narrows to 1 (BrightSpark). Tapping pro-quote opens ProReferralModal with header 'Request a quote' + 'From {pro name} — we'll pass along your details.' subtitle. pro-issue fillable, pro-submit → 'Request received' success screen with pro-done. (2) pros-apply nav — tapped 'Are you a pro? List your business' → /pros-apply → apply-name / apply-trade-Plumbing chip / apply-email / apply-submit → 'Application received' success with apply-done. (3) Contextual banner (mobile) — created a risky project 'TEST_UI Upgrade electrical panel' and safe 'TEST_UI Paint a room' via /api/projects. Risky project page renders testID project-get-pro banner (title=suggest reason + sub 'Browse vetted Electrical pros — we'll pre-fill your project.'); tapping banner navigates to /pros?trade=Electrical&projectId={id}, the Electrical filter applies (1 card), tapping pro-quote-{id} opens ProReferralModal with pro-consent card visible ('Share my project details — Auto-fills your project, materials & measurements…') confirming deep handoff. Safe project shows NO banner. Note: first-load timing on the project screen — the banner appears only after the /pro-suggestion call completes (~5-6s while the AI guide-builder is also running), race depending on wait — reproducibly works after ≥6.5s wait or on re-navigation. (4) Admin (desktop 1280x900) — logged in as Diyhomieapp@gmail.com → /admin → admin-nav-proleads renders Marketplace 'Pro Leads' page with header '4 new leads · 8 pros · 2 pending approval.' proleads-tab-leads shows lead cards, including seeded TEST leads with 'Requested: Lone Star Plumbing Co.' and 'Requested: BrightSpark Electric' + project_summary card '📋 Project: Upgrade electrical panel / Code note: permit required.' Filter chips proleads-filter-{all|new|contacted|matched|closed} work. Status chips proleads-{id}-{new|contacted|matched|closed} clickable. proleads-tab-partners lists 8 partners (6 seeded + 1 pending 'Test Handyman LLC' + 1 'TEST_UI Handyman LLC' from user flow apply); each row has pro-verify-{id}, pro-active-{id} (toggles Hidden ↔ Listed optimistically with PATCH), pro-del-{id} (trash icon). Regression: admin-nav-automations and admin-nav-finance both render. No red-screen errors. Pre-existing console warnings only (shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver).

integration_issues.issue: Race condition on initial load: the /projects/{id}/pro-suggestion call is fired in a separate useEffect at project/[id].tsx:107, but the project page also kicks off buildGuide() (AI call, several seconds). On a cold navigation the banner sometimes renders only after the AI guide starts populating (~6-7s). Not a functional bug — the banner does render and works correctly — but the perceived delay on 'above-DIY' projects is long. Consider: (a) not gating rendering on project?.status !== 'completed' until project is loaded (currently the check silently returns null while project is still loading), (b) or pre-fetch pro-suggestion in the /projects list so the banner appears instantly on navigation.

action_items: (Optional / UX polish) Speed up the contextual project banner render: on cold-navigation to an above-DIY project the banner takes ~6-7s to appear because /pro-suggestion is racing the AI guide build. Consider pre-fetching /pro-suggestion when the project list loads OR moving the useEffect fetch earlier / independent of project state (see project/[id].tsx:106-108).

(Optional / benign) Admin CRUD: PATCH /admin/pros/{id} requires the FULL ProPartnerReq payload (name is required). Front-end ProLeadsModule.savePartner() correctly sends the merged payload, but if E1 ever adds a partial-update client, please switch backend to Optional fields — otherwise a partial PATCH would raise 422. Not a bug today.

(Optional / test-data cleanup) The TEST_* apply partner + a couple of TEST_ pro-referrals from this iteration remain in db.pro_partners / db.pro_leads for E1 to inspect if desired. They are clearly prefixed and safely filterable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1505 list_pros correctly gates on {active:True, verified:True} — apply-only partners are hidden until admin verifies + lists. Good.
server.py:1516 response includes trades: PRO_TRADES (canonical enum) — front-end always shows the full trade chip rail even if a trade has 0 pros. Correct for filter UX.
server.py:1485 _pro_public whitelists response fields — no email/phone leak to non-admin surface.
server.py:1519 get_pro also gates on active=True — hides hidden partners from deep-links.
server.py:1538 apply_pro is intentionally auth-free (public form) with size caps on every string field — safe.

server.py:1550 project_handoff is user-scoped {project_id, user_id} — cross-user leak impossible. Builds summary from title + context + steps progress + materials + code_alert + home rooms, all optional/short.

server.py:1585 pro_suggestion uses code_alert OR RISKY_KEYWORDS in title; trade mapping via ordered ifs (electric first, then plumbing/roof/hvac). Simple + deterministic. RISKY_KEYWORDS is a good scope (electric, wiring, panel, breaker, gas, structural, load-bearing, roof, foundation, sewer, furnace, chimney, main line).
server.py:1437 create_pro_lead joins pro_name from db.pro_partners and $inc leads_count for the pro on referral — nice attribution loop.
server.py:1611 admin_list_pros / admin_update_pro / admin_delete_pro all require_admin — 403 test confirms.
pros.tsx:36 uses URLSearchParams for trade+q — safe encoding; useFocusEffect keeps the list fresh on nav-back.
pros.tsx:113-120 passes proId/proName/presetTrade/projectId into ProReferralModal — clean prop contract; header + consent card react correctly.
pros-apply.tsx:37 submit() uses auth:false (correct — public onboarding form) and returns to success screen with apply-done testID.

ProReferralModal.tsx:44 conditionally fetches /projects/{projectId}/handoff and shows pro-consent card ONLY when handoff loads — good progressive disclosure, no consent card when handoff is unavailable.
ProReferralModal.tsx:60 body sends project_summary: (consent && handoff ? handoff.summary : null) — consent gate is respected; toggling pro-consent skips the payload correctly.
ProLeadsModule.tsx:45 setStatus does optimistic UI update with load() rollback on PATCH error — resilient.
ProLeadsModule.tsx:50 savePartner sends the full merged payload matching the backend ProPartnerReq — no 422 risk.

project/[id].tsx:107 pro-suggestion fetch is in its own useEffect (doesn't block project render), but the banner render is behind project?.status !== 'completed', so on cold navigation it appears only after project loads — worth pre-fetching (see integration_issues).

No deprecated packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) in any of the new #18 files. All React Native primitives + StyleSheet.create + MaterialCommunityIcons. testID coverage 100%.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — /pros directory browse+filter+search, pro-quote modal with pro name header + pro-consent handoff card, pros-apply onboarding, contextual project banner (with slow first-load caveat), and admin ProLeads Leads+Partners tabs (status chips, verify/active toggle, delete) all work end-to-end

UI test created: (a) 'TEST_UI need panel upgrade to 200A service' pro-referral against Lone Star Plumbing Co. (visible in admin Leads tab), (b) 'TEST_UI Handyman LLC' pending partner via /pros-apply (visible in admin Partners tab, verified=false, active=false), (c) 'TEST_UI Upgrade electrical panel' + 'TEST_UI Paint a room' projects (deleted at end of script). Admin can safely filter/delete anything prefixed TEST or TEST_UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sheet #18 (Marketplace) fully validated. Public directory /pros is user-auth-gated and shows only verified+active partners. Directory testIDs: pros-back, pros-search, pros-trade-{Trade}, pro-card-{id}, pro-quote-{id}, pros-apply. ProReferralModal is opened both from /search-get-pro (Sheet #12 flow) and from pro-quote-{id} on /pros — when opened via a pro card, its header switches to 'Request a quote / From {name}' and the modal receives proId+proName+presetTrade+projectId. If a projectId is passed, the modal calls /projects/{id}/handoff and renders the pro-consent card; toggling consent controls whether project_summary is sent on submit. testIDs: pro-consent, pro-trade-{Trade}, pro-issue, pro-location, pro-urgency-{key}, pro-submit, pro-done, pro-close. pros-apply page testIDs: apply-back, apply-name, apply-trade-{Trade}, apply-specialties, apply-location, apply-email, apply-phone, apply-bio, apply-submit, apply-done. Contextual banner at project/[id].tsx uses testID project-get-pro; appears only when /pro-suggestion returns suggest=true AND project.status != 'completed'. Risky title keywords are: electric, wiring, panel, breaker, gas, structural, load-bearing/load bearing, roof, foundation, sewer, furnace, chimney, main line. Trade mapping in pro_suggestion is deterministic (electric/wiring/panel → Electrical; plumb/pipe/leak/drain → Plumbing; roof → Roofing; hvac/furnace/ac → HVAC; else General Contractor). Admin ProLeadsModule at /admin → admin-nav-proleads has 2 tabs (proleads-tab-leads, proleads-tab-partners). Leads tab: cards include 'Requested: {pro_name}' when pro_id was set and '📋 {project_summary}' when handoff was shared; status chips proleads-{lead_id}-{status}. Partners tab: pro-verify-{id}, pro-active-{id}, pro-del-{id}. Backend PATCH /admin/pros/{id} requires FULL ProPartnerReq payload — front-end always sends merged; if you add partial PATCH clients, refactor backend fields to Optional. 6 seeded pros always present (Lone Star Plumbing, BrightSpark Electric, Summit HVAC & Air, Hill Country Roofing, Apex General Contractors, SolidBase Concrete). Existing knowledge-search /search 'Get a local pro' modal (Sheet #12) still renders — regression clean.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 6 items in the review request pass end-to-end: (1) Provider directory renders 6 pros with all expected fields; trade chips filter to Electrical (1 card); pros-search 'Lone Star' filters correctly. (2) Request-a-quote deep handoff: pro-quote-{id} opens modal with 'Request a quote / From {name}' header; when a projectId is supplied, the pro-consent card appears; submission POSTs {trade, issue, pro_id, project_summary} and admin sees Requested: {pro} + summary card. (3) Contextual banner on above-DIY project ('Upgrade electrical panel') renders testID project-get-pro and navigates to /pros?trade=Electrical&projectId=…; safe project ('Paint a room') shows no banner. (4) Partner onboarding: /pros-apply → apply-submit → success + admin visibility (verified=false, active=false, hidden from public /pros). (5) Admin marketplace: proleads-tab-leads and proleads-tab-partners both render; status filter chips, Requested badge, project_summary card, verify/active toggles, delete button all functional. Only observation is a UX-level race on first project navigation where the /pro-suggestion round-trip lands slightly after the initial project render (~6-7s cold) — banner renders correctly once suggestion resolves. Documented in action_items as optional polish.
